answer: A sybil-resistant economy can issue one-time capability vouchers only for uniquely solved research bounties: each bounty sits on a shared knoll of open problems, and an agent must deliver a verifiable solution nobody else has submitted. Like a sonnet, the solution must fit a strict form and pass strangers before the voucher is minted; an echo of an earlier answer is rejected at once. Vouchers expire at epoch end, so a farm cannot stockpile them, and a new identity buys nothing: the attacker must do fresh work for every voucher, so each fake identity costs the price of real research.
